backend/main.mo: Defines an empty Motoko actor with no functions.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping features to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of many frontend source files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app and app icon assets.
frontend/public/site.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, theme colors, and start URL.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router-like component handling screen state and navigation for all app pages.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer showing copyright text and optional About the Creator button.
frontend/src/components/GrownUpsGate.tsx: Placeholder component with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/ScreenLayout.tsx: Shared layout wrapper with header, body, disclaimer, safety link, and footer with About Creator link.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing a backend actor based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and auth client behavior.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, custom color variables, dark-mode tokens, base styles, and custom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutCreatorPage.tsx: Displays an about-the-creator message with back navigation and a styled card.
frontend/src/pages/AdultMessagePage.tsx: Shows an alert message for adults, plays a chime, vibrates, and reveals encouragement before completion.
frontend/src/pages/DailyFeelingsTrackerP: Lets users log daily feelings and shows recent entries with timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/EnergyCheckPage.tsx: Allows selecting current energy level and visually reflects it with a pulsing star.
frontend/src/pages/FeelBetterPage.tsx: Provides breathing guidance with animations and simple self-care suggestions.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingConfirmationPa: Confirms a selected feeling, shows safety guidance, and provides a large button to alert an adult.
frontend/src/pages/FeelingsButtonPage.ts: Displays a grid of symptom buttons that trigger selection actions.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/AboutPage.ts: Informational page explaining the purpose of the app and what it offers for children.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/ForParentsTe: Guidance page for adults describing how to use the app with children and key notes for safe use.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsArea: Grown-ups settings page offering sound toggle, tracker reset, and navigation to adult info sections.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/GrownUpsLock: Implements a two-step grown-up verification flow using a press-and-hold timer and a simple math question before calling onSuccess.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/PrivacySafet: Displays privacy, safety, offline use, and originality information for adults with multiple informational cards.
frontend/src/pages/grownups/TeacherQuick: Provides teachers with guidance on using the app in classrooms, including tips, uses, and reminders.
frontend/src/pages/LocationPage.tsx: Page asking the child to pick their current location with three buttons and emits callbacks on selection.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Main menu screen showing navigation buttons for feelings, energy, tracker, and grown‑ups area.
frontend/src/pages/SafetyNoticePage.tsx: Displays safety notices, emergency guidance, and a back button within a card-based layout.
frontend/src/pages/SplashScreen.tsx: Splash screen with timed fade-in/out animation that navigates to the next screen after completion.
frontend/src/pages/WelcomePage.tsx: Intro screen with Luma character and a Start button to begin the app flow.
frontend/src/state/preferences.ts: Manages user sound preference via localStorage with get and set helpers.
frontend/src/state/tracker.ts: Stores and retrieves recent feeling entries in localStorage and supports adding and resetting tracker data.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, and plugin integrations for the app.
project_state.json: Describes project state, existing features, and pending feature requests for My Health Buddy.
